description: Units, property descriptions, and route text are loaded from one catalog document. This list is not built by scanning one tehsil file. apis is one summary per route: id, group (dataset or waterbody), path, method, title, description, select_param, property_count, properties_url, and href. GET /api/v2/catalog/{api_id}/ adds parameters and properties. Each property has name, type, unit, description, and selectable. Names with selectable true are what you pass to fields= on MWS fortnight metrics and KYL indicators, or to data= on tehsil sheets. For get_tehsil_data, unit is a map of column name to measurement unit, the same map returned as tehsil_units. Omit data, or pass data=all, to receive every sheet present in that tehsil's file. The catalog lists sheets the platform can produce; a given tehsil file may include only some of them.

tehsil_data_all.name: all
tehsil_data_all.description: Every CoRE Stack dataset generated for this tehsil. This is the default when data is omitted. The response includes the sheets that are actually present in that tehsil's file.

apis.title: Get Admin Details by Lat Lon
apis.description: Resolve a latitude and longitude to the State, District, and Tehsil names CoRE Stack uses to store datasets. Copy those three names into the other dataset APIs, such as tehsil data, micro-watershed geometries, generated layers, and waterbodies. latitude and longitude are required WGS84 coordinates, and the point must fall inside the Survey of India boundary. Confirm the tehsil is listed by Get Active Locations before you request its datasets.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: WGS84 latitude (-90 to 90)

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: WGS84 longitude (-180 to 180)

apis.title: Get MWSID by Lat Lon
apis.description: Resolve a latitude and longitude to the micro-watershed that contains that point. It returns uid, which you pass as mws_id to the time series, KYL indicators, geometry, and watershed report, together with the State, District, and Tehsil names for that watershed. latitude and longitude are required WGS84 coordinates.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: WGS84 latitude (-90 to 90)

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: WGS84 longitude (-180 to 180)

apis.title: Get Tehsil Data
apis.description: Return the analytical datasets CoRE Stack has generated for one tehsil, including drought, hydrology, land use, MGNREGA, and the other sheets listed here. state, district, and tehsil must be the names from Get Active Locations or Get Admin Details by Lat Lon. Omit data, or pass data=all, for every sheet in that tehsil's file. Pass data=drought,stream_order to keep named sheets. Each sheet is one row per micro-watershed. Each property unit is that sheet's column units, the same map returned as tehsil_units. A tehsil file may contain only some of the sheets listed in this catalog.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: District name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Tehsil / block name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Omit or all for every dataset in this tehsil's file. Or sheet names such as drought,stream_order

properties.name: aquifer_vector
properties.description: Aquifer class and area share per MWS

properties.name: canal
properties.description: Canal network intersection with the MWS

properties.name: drought
properties.description: Drought frequency / weeks (if present as a sheet)

properties.name: factory_csr
properties.description: Factory / CSR sites intersecting the MWS

properties.name: lulc_vector
properties.description: Land use / land cover class shares

properties.name: mws_intersect_swb
properties.description: Surface water bodies intersecting the MWS

apis.title: Get MWS Time Series Data
apis.description: Fortnight hydrology time series for one micro-watershed: evapotranspiration, runoff, and precipitation, in steps of about 15 days. Requires state, district, tehsil, and mws_id, the uid from Get MWSID by Lat Lon. Pass fields=et,runoff to keep only those metrics. time is always returned. Values are in millimetres.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: District name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Tehsil / block name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: mws_id
parameters.description: Micro-watershed identifier, e.g. 12_208104

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated fortnight metrics: et, runoff, precipitation

properties.name: time
properties.description: Period start date for each ~15-day step

apis.title: Get MWS KYL Indicators
apis.description: Single-row Know Your Landscape snapshot for one micro-watershed. This is not a time series. It includes terrain class, average rainfall, drought category, cropping, and asset counts. Requires state, district, tehsil, and mws_id. Pass fields=avg_runoff,drought_category to keep named indicators. mws_id is always returned. Each property unit is mm, ha, count, or a class label.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: District name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Tehsil / block name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: mws_id
parameters.description: Micro-watershed identifier, e.g. 12_208104

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated indicator names from this catalog

apis.title: Get Generated Layer URL
apis.description: GeoServer URLs for every generated layer in a tehsil. Requires the same state, district, and tehsil names as Get Active Locations. Each record has a layer_url: WFS for vectors and WCS for rasters. Open that URL to read the raw layer in QGIS or any WFS or WCS client.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: District name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Tehsil / block name from Get Active Locations

properties.name: gee_asset_path
properties.description: earth engine asset id or null

apis.title: Get MWS Report URL
apis.description: URL of the PDF or HTML report for one micro-watershed. Requires state, district, tehsil, and mws_id. The tehsil stats file and the micro-watershed layer must already exist. Open Mws_report_url to read the report.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: District name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Tehsil / block name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: mws_id
parameters.description: Micro-watershed identifier, e.g. 12_208104

properties.name: Mws_report_url
properties.description: mws pdf or html report url

apis.title: Get MWS Geometry
apis.description: Micro-watershed polygons for a tehsil as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Requires state, district, and tehsil. Omit mws_id to return every watershed in the tehsil. Pass mws_id for one feature. Coordinates are longitude, latitude in degrees. Save the collection to open it in QGIS.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: District name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Tehsil / block name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: mws_id
parameters.description: Optional; omit to return every MWS in the tehsil

apis.title: Get Village Geometries
apis.description: Village and panchayat polygons for a tehsil as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Requires state, district, and tehsil. Omit village_id for the whole tehsil. Pass village_id (vill_ID) for one village. Coordinates are longitude, latitude in degrees. Save the collection to open it in QGIS.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: District name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Tehsil / block name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: village_id
parameters.description: Optional vill_ID; omit for the whole tehsil

apis.title: Get Active Locations
apis.description: State, district, and tehsil names where the full public dataset is already generated. This list is not every tehsil in India. Use the returned names as the exact state, district, and tehsil values on the other dataset APIs. Optional filters state, district, and tehsil (alias block) are case-insensitive. If a tehsil is missing, request it with the Geospatial Data Request Form.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional state filter

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: Optional district filter

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Optional tehsil filter (alias: block)

parameters.name: block
parameters.description: Optional block filter (same as tehsil)

apis.title: Get Waterbodies by admin data
apis.description: Merged remotely sensed waterbodies for a tehsil, detected by the IIT Delhi method and implemented by the CoRE Stack team. Requires state, district, and tehsil. The response is the full inventory for that tehsil, including area in hectares, zone of influence, and cropping intensity. Pass regenerate=true to rebuild the merge.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: district
parameters.description: District name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Tehsil / block name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: regenerate
parameters.description: Set true to rebuild the merge

apis.title: Get Waterbodies by uid
apis.description: One waterbody from the merged remotely sensed dataset, keyed by UID. Requires state, district, tehsil, and uid, for example 12_100174_104. Call Get Waterbodies by admin data first when you need the list of UIDs. Pass regenerate=true to rebuild the merge.

parameters.name: state

parameters.name: district

parameters.name: tehsil
parameters.description: Tehsil / block name from Get Active Locations

parameters.name: uid
